note: Corps of Engineers campground on the upper arm of Buckhorn Lake near Hazard. Sites S-11 to S-28 line an open, grassy shore; the rest back to a wooded hillside across the road. The campground is low-lying and floods when the lake is high. Playground, basketball, horseshoe pits and a fishing area. --Claude
